text:
Type: off-white wall or clamp spotlight
Use: reading or directed light beside a bed, a sofa or a desk; bedroom, living room, home office
Style: industrial, retro, Scandinavian
Materials: off-white lacquered steel shade, brass-coloured bracket and hinge, chrome spring clamp, black and white braided textile cord with switch
Colors: warm off-white, brass gold, black and white
Shape: small bell shade on a hinged arm, mounts on a wall or clamps to a shelf with a spring clip, adjustable, compact
Feel: charming, crafted, vintage, warm
Goes with: wood shelves, white walls, brass or black accents; industrial, farmhouse or Scandinavian rooms

product.name: RANARP
product.description: The lamp has got double function - you can use it as a clamp spotlight or assemble it on the wall as a wall lamp.
